import json
BG='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl-u1-turns/frozen/seen/play/users/u075/system/state/workspace/programs'
pairs=json.load(open(BG+'/task-b62da9e0.json'))
prog='''from collections import Counter,deque

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==c:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
                ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                hh=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; ww=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
                if hh>=2 and ww>=2 and len(comp)/(hh*ww)>=0.5:
                    for y in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1):
                        for x in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1):
                            out[y][x]=c
    return out
'''
